resources.string: The screen will forget its list and show a new code to add it from the manager. Are you sure?

For ADPOSTER LINK to open by itself every time the power comes back, Android needs the “Display over other apps” permission. It is given once: on the screen that opens, find ADPOSTER LINK and turn it on.

This device does not let the app open that setting. Find it in Settings › Apps › Special app access › Display over other apps, or turn it on once from a computer with: adb shell appops set com.mediaservi.adposterlink SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow
Done. Now press OK: Android will ask which home screen to use. Choose ADPOSTER LINK and “Always”. To undo it, come back to this menu.
Full kiosk mode turned off: the device goes back to its usual home screen.
